title: The Snow Angel beside the First
youtube_title: The Snow Angel beside the First | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Teo is just outside the fun, close to a space beside the first snow angel. Esme changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Teo has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
